parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
Six different compounds or complexes, **H**, **J**, **K**, **L**, **M** and **N**, are formed when an excess of aqueous $\text{NH}_3$, aqueous $\text{NaOH}$ and concentrated aqueous $\text{HCl}$ are separately added to separate solutions containing $\text{Cu}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ or $\text{Co}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$.

| reagent |  |  |  |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| solution | an excess of $\text{NH}_3\text{(aq)}$ | an excess of $\text{NaOH}\text{(aq)}$ | an excess of concentrated $\text{HCl}\text{(aq)}$ |
| $\text{Cu}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ | **H** | **J** | **K** |
| $\text{Co}^{2+}\text{(aq)}$ | **L** | **M** | **N** |
